snippet.title: Brain Hack Squad - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wish list on Steam at http://s.team/a/2985970

Shoot, hack, and kidnap as you lead cybernetic agents in real time tactical combat with pause. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants as your battle rival groups for control of the city.
